definitions.gloss: as expected; as hoped; according to expectations
definitions.explanation: Describes a result or outcome that matches what was anticipated or hoped for.

examples.japanese: {期待通|きたいどお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧だった。
⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{期待通|きたいどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{売|う}れた→売れる：02012_ureru⟧。
examples.english: The new product sold well, just as expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{期待通|きたいどお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: He performed just as well as we had hoped.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as an adverb or as a no-adjective modifying nouns. Often appears in sentences evaluating outcomes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {期待通|きたいどお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (the expected result)
- {期待通|きたいどお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧ (the expected achievement)
- {期待通|きたいどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (to proceed as expected)

RELATED PATTERNS:
Other 〜{通|どお}り patterns: ⟦{予想通|よそうどお}り→予想通り：16795_yosoudoori⟧ (as predicted), {計画通|けいかくどお}り (as planned), ⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ (as one thought).
